decisions.title: Clock architecture
decisions.recommended_option: C-prime: 50 MHz core, internal /2 25 MHz peripheral, external 32.768 kHz AON
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Owner-signed ARC-006 entry and SDC clock plan

decisions.title: CDC architecture and verification scope
decisions.recommended_option: Scope follows ARC-006 C-prime: core/periph synchronous handshake, core/AON asynchronous with 2-FF and handshakes; formal properties for AON wake, reset release, APB handshake
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved CDC scope and property list

decisions.title: External clock source (Si5351)
decisions.recommended_option: Keep external 50 MHz source; do not integrate a PLL
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Existing PLL decision report; confirm board source in Stage 1 package

decisions.title: Formal CDC properties
decisions.recommended_option: Replace three-domain async-FIFO proposal with property set matching implemented crossings: reset synchronizers, AON wake handshake, APB request/response, PLIC interrupt sync
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved property list and harness map

decisions.title: SRAM macro strategy
decisions.recommended_option: 32-bit wide 128 KB and 32 KB macros with multi-corner Liberty; do not tile the 4 KB 128-bit macro
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Macro availability/area evidence or revised area target

decisions.title: Power intent and domains
decisions.recommended_option: Two SoC domains at 1.8 V (AON + switchable core/periph), external PMIC rails for 1.0/3.3 V board domains; UPF for the two SoC domains
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved power-intent architecture and UPF scope

decisions.title: Secure boot scope
decisions.recommended_option: Option S1: hardware SHA-256 + ECDSA-P256 verifier and OTP/key store, or explicitly descope secure boot and remove security claims; do not ship fail-closed-only as 'secure boot'
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Security scope decision with implementation or descope rationale

decisions.title: SDC primary clock period
decisions.recommended_option: 50 MHz core + 25 MHz generated peripheral clock; retire the conflicting 20 ns/40 ns files

decisions.title: Package pin budget and pinmux
decisions.recommended_option: Remove 32-bit ext_irq and three internal handshake pins from the package; mux 8 PLIC sources onto GPIO alternate functions; add BOOT_MODE[1:0], PMIC_ALERT/IRQ, RF_CTRL[1:0], UART1; total 54 of 56 I/O
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved pin table matching RTL top ports

decisions.title: DFT scope and tooling
decisions.recommended_option: Decide scan/ATPG tool or partner before Stage 7; scan insertion must precede synthesis freeze

decisions.title: Requirements baseline and descopes
decisions.recommended_option: Re-baseline SRS to the implementable product: RV32IM machine-mode, 1 UART, 1 SPI, 1 I2C, 16 GPIO, 4 PWM, 1 I2S TX, CLINT/PLIC 8 sources, 16 KB ROM/32 KB TCM/128 KB SRAM; defer crypto, OTA, second UART, LPTIM until Stage 2+ or second silicon; every descope owner-signed
decisions.approval_evidence_required: Approved SRS revision and descope register

summary.reason: Mandatory decisions require user/design-owner approval; Stage 1 stops at READY FOR APPROVAL.
